proof source = canvas composite in WORKING_PROFILE_LINEAR_SRGB, read back as the frame's 8-bit sRGB bytes decoded to linear light; display profile sRGB v4; working_rgb proofs to the same working space; working_cmyk = document working_space_cmyk else the vector records' CMYK StudioIccProfile marked working_space (bytes from the vector entry), refused proof_no_cmyk_working_profile otherwise
ICC proof profile reference = SCPF id + sha256 of a StudioIccProfile in the vector records (Folio checks the shape, the host resolves bytes and the digest)
shipped preset names are Prism's; a saved condition may not reuse one; shipped presets as records carry Prism's defaults (relative/relative, BPC on, paper/ink off)

choosing a condition (Proof Setup, Custom, Colour-Vision) turns Proof Colours on; a toggle with no active condition selects working_cmyk when resolvable else working_rgb; Proof Colours / Gamut Warning on without an active condition is refused by Folio
Save Proof Preset saves the active condition under a new name, the active condition stays
gamut warning without Proof Colours overlays the unproofed frame (frame bytes / 255 as display RGB); every pixel judged incl. transparent ones, alpha kept
GPU shared-device frames: proof view on the render-cpu read-back (declared, state read_back); frames above MAX_WIDE_PIXELS refused proof_pixel_limit
